design_rules: No via in pad. Do not place a via inside an SMD land, tangent to one, or closer than 0.2 mm hole-edge to pad-edge (the point where the solder mask dam between via and pad disappears at this board's 0.5/0.3 mm via geometry and zero mask expansion). Enforced by the "no-via-in-pad" rule in isolator.kicad_dru. This includes exposed thermal pads — if an EP needs a thermal via, raise it rather than assuming the exception.
